title: SignId
description: Sign identifier event published by the text-to-gloss Lambda onto the signstream-bus EventBridge bus with detail-type 'signstream.signId'. One event per sign to play. The primary delivery path of sign IDs back to the client is direct push through the API Gateway management API; this event is an internal fan-out for analytics, observability, and any future side-channel consumers.

connectionId.description: API Gateway WebSocket connection ID of the originating client session.

language.description: Target sign language. Must match the language prefix of signId.

signId.description: Stable dictionary key in the format <language>-<gloss-slug>-<version>. Versioning lets the dictionary improve a pose clip without invalidating client caches of older clips. Example: asl-hello-v1.

gloss.description: Optional. The canonical gloss (uppercased, hyphenated) the sign was mapped from, e.g. HELLO, THANK-YOU. Useful for debugging when a sign ID is not playing as expected.

sourceText.description: Optional. The original transcript fragment that produced this sign. Useful for end-to-end traceability in observability tools.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when text-to-gloss emitted this event.

transcriptPublishedAt.description: Optional. publishedAt of the transcript event this sign was derived from. Pair with publishedAt to measure text-to-gloss latency.
